pages.title: Last Entry
pages.text: $(bold)DUTY LOG$()$(br)Okoye, A., last on the roster$(br2)Why I am here: the recall came June 18 and someone had to see the vault shut. I said I would stay a day. The others went up to Exodus.

The doors stopped for me when the others left. My sidearm is not in its holster, and I do not remember taking it off.$(br2)The wand's log says 0. I checked it twice. I will check again when I have slept.$(br2)I am going to lie down now. Nobody is watching.
